question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "achieve".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Achieve**" means to **accomplish something**.

 
 
• **Example:** *Diana **achieved** in convincing her parents for a night out. *
 
 
 
• The blank demands a word that means "**completed something successfully**". 
 
• Therefore, "achieve" is the appropriate option. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appreciate** - praise a person or an object.

 
 
• **Example:** *The boss **appreciated** his team for their hard work.*
 
 
 
• **Prevail** - existing at the time.
 
 
• **Example:** *The **prevailing** orders must be shipped by tomorrow. *
 
 
 
• **Value** - of some benefit. 
 
 
• **Example:** *This chair is of great **value** as it is made up of sandal wood. *
